SELECT T1.CHL_FINPROD_ID COUNTER_ID, T8.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T8.FINPROD_NAME COUNTER_NAME, T2.YIELD clientYield,
T2.vatTaxRate vatTaxRate, T2.adtTaxRate adtTaxRate,
T3.YIELD managerYield, T4.YIELD otherYield, T5.CUSTOMER_NAME manager_CustomerName, T6.CUSTOMER_NAME client_CustomerName, T7.ACCT_NO BUSI_ACCT_NO, T9.PAY_TYPE FROM ( SELECT T12.FINPROD_ID, T12.CHL_FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_CASH_INFO T12 WHERE T12.CASH_TYPE_2 IN ( #{cashType02c11}, #{cashType02c12}, #{cashType02c13} ) GROUP BY T12.CHL_FINPROD_ID, T12.FINPROD_ID ) T1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT T11.FINPROD_ID, T11.CASH_TYPE_2, T11.CHL_FINPROD_ID,
T81.VAT_TAX_RATE*100 vatTaxRate, T81.ADT_TAX_RATE*100 adtTaxRate,
T31.YIELD * 100 YIELD FROM FIN_CASH_INFO T11 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T21 ON T2.FINPROD_ID = T11.FINPROD_ID
left join PA_FIN_PRODUCT T81 on T11.CHL_FINPROD_ID = T81.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T31 ON T31.CASH_ID = T11.CASH_ID AND T31.EFF_DATE = T21.VDATE WHERE T11.CASH_TYPE_2 IN ( #{cashType02c11}, #{cashType02c12}, #{cashType02c13} )) T2 ON T2.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T2.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType02c11} AND T2.CHL_FINPROD_ID = T1.CHL_FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT T11.FINPROD_ID, T11.CASH_TYPE_2, T11.CHL_FINPROD_ID,
T81.VAT_TAX_RATE*100 vatTaxRate, T81.ADT_TAX_RATE*100 adtTaxRate,
T31.YIELD * 100 YIELD FROM FIN_CASH_INFO T11 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T21 ON T2.FINPROD_ID = T11.FINPROD_ID
left join PA_FIN_PRODUCT T81 on T11.CHL_FINPROD_ID = T81.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T31 ON T31.CASH_ID = T11.CASH_ID AND T31.EFF_DATE = T21.VDATE WHERE T11.CASH_TYPE_2 IN ( #{cashType02c11}, #{cashType02c12}, #{cashType02c13} )) T3 ON T3.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T3.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType02c12} AND T3.CHL_FINPROD_ID = T1.CHL_FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT T11.FINPROD_ID, T11.CASH_TYPE_2, T11.CHL_FINPROD_ID,
T81.VAT_TAX_RATE*100 vatTaxRate, T81.ADT_TAX_RATE*100 adtTaxRate,
T31.YIELD * 100 YIELD FROM FIN_CASH_INFO T11 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T21 ON T2.FINPROD_ID = T11.FINPROD_ID
left join PA_FIN_PRODUCT T81 on T11.CHL_FINPROD_ID = T81.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T31 ON T31.CASH_ID = T11.CASH_ID AND T31.EFF_DATE = T21.VDATE WHERE T11.CASH_TYPE_2 IN ( #{cashType02c11}, #{cashType02c12}, #{cashType02c13} )) T4 ON T4.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T4.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType02c13} AND T4.CHL_FINPROD_ID = T1.CHL_FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T8 ON T8.FINPROD_ID = T1.CHL_FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T5 ON T5.CUSTOMER_ID = T8.MANAGER LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T6 ON T6.CUSTOMER_ID = T8.TRUSTEE_ID LEFT JOIN STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT T7 ON T7.FINPROD_ID = T8.FINPROD_ID AND T7.CCY = 'CNY' LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T9 ON T9.FINPROD_ID = T1.CHL_FINPROD_ID
AND T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T1.FINPROD_NAME counterName, T2.YIELD clientYield, T3.YIELD managerYield, T4.YIELD otherYield,
T8.VAT_TAX_RATE*100 vatTaxRate, T8.ADT_TAX_RATE*100 adtTaxRate,
T5.CUSTOMER_NAME manager_CustomerName, T6.CUSTOMER_NAME client_CustomerName, T7.ACCT_NO BUSI_ACCT_NO, T9.PAY_TYPE FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.CASH_TYPE_2, T3.YIELD * 100 YIELD FROM FIN_CASH_INFO T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T2.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T3 ON T3.CASH_ID = T1.CASH_ID AND T3.EFF_DATE = T2.VDATE ) T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID AND T2.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType02c11} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.CASH_TYPE_2, T3.YIELD * 100 YIELD FROM FIN_CASH_INFO T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T2.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T3 ON T3.CASH_ID = T1.CASH_ID AND T3.EFF_DATE = T2.VDATE ) T3 ON T3.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T3.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType02c12} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.CASH_TYPE_2, T3.YIELD * 100 YIELD FROM FIN_CASH_INFO T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T2.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T3 ON T3.CASH_ID = T1.CASH_ID AND T3.EFF_DATE = T2.VDATE ) T4 ON T4.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T4.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType02c13} LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T5 ON T5.CUSTOMER_ID = T1.MANAGER LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T6 ON T6.CUSTOMER_ID = T1.TRUSTEE_ID LEFT JOIN STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT T7 ON T7.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID
AND T7.CCY = 'CNY'
left join PA_FIN_PRODUCT T8 on T1.FINPROD_ID = T8.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T9 on T9.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID
AND T1.FINPROD_ID = #{counterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
